nodes.name: Sync Deal & Contact Tags: move-opportunity-stage
nodes.notes: Replaces the old narrow 'Untag Previous Stage'/'Tag New Stage' pair (which only removed the ONE specific previous-stage tag, letting older stray stage tags accumulate — e.g. dragging a card backward could leave a newer stage's tag still attached). Delegates to the Deal Stage Tag Sync Engine webhook, which removes ANY stray stage tag (for both the deal and its linked contact) before applying the current one. onError continues regardless — a tag-sync hiccup should never block the actual stage move from succeeding/responding.
